    EncryptedTransport.stampTransportWrappedDek(String ttioPath, byte[] wrappedDek, String kekAlgorithm, List<EncryptedTransport.Recipient> additionalRecipients, String providerName)
    Multi-recipient overload (FD-1 Phase A): the same DEK wrapped under ``additionalRecipients``' keys is stamped as the <channel>_wrapped_dek_recipients attribute and emitted as the packet's trailing block.
    static void
    EncryptedTransport.stampTransportWrappedDek(String ttioPath, byte[] wrappedDek, String kekAlgorithm, List<EncryptedTransport.Recipient> additionalRecipients, String serverKekId, String providerName)
    FD-1 C-2a overload: also stamps <channel>_server_kek_id (the opaque label naming the KEK under which the primary wrapped_dek is wrapped), so writeEncryptedDataset emits it in the packet and the daemon can decide server-processability.
